corpus: SYNTHETIC DEMO TERMS (illustrative only). The personal loan carries an annual rate of 7.99 percent APR, fixed for the life of the loan. The personal loan has a maximum term of 60 months from the disbursement date. The personal loan origination fee is 2 percent of the amount advanced, deducted at closing. The credit line carries an annual rate of 12.5 percent APR, variable with the prime rate. The credit line minimum payment is 25 dollars per statement cycle, or the accrued interest if greater. The savings account earns an annual rate of 4.25 percent, compounded daily and credited monthly. The savings account requires a minimum balance of 500 dollars monthly to avoid the service charge. The overdraft fee is 35 dollars per occurrence, assessed at end of business day. The overdraft grace period is 3 days from the date the account goes negative. The late payment fee is 39 dollars flat, applied once per billing period. The late payment grace period is 15 days after the scheduled due date. The wire transfer fee is 30 dollars for domestic transfers sent before the cutoff.
